snippet.title: Mind's Eye Macrogolf [Release Trailer]
snippet.description:
Mind's Eye Macrogolf is a free online fantasy minigolf game for 1 to 10 players.

Roll and lob your eyeball to victory across 18 fantastical levels in the Lands Above the Clouds, a once flourishing realm now fallen victim to the ruthless onslaught of time. Will you hone your skills and master the venerable art of ocular minigolf, or will you follow the path of civilizations lost and fight like crabs in an eyeball bucket until none are left standing? Only you can decide.

Features:
- Online multiplayer for up to 10 players
- Physics-based game play
- Full 18-hole course
- Interactive level elements like boosters, wind zones and more!

Download (PC): https://tinyurl.com/macrogolf
Monster Moon: https://monstermoon.io

Trailer music: "Spinning out" by jhaeka (joshuuu.itch.io)
